items.title: Free No-Login .env Diff & Drift Checker
items.summary: Paste .env and .env.example side-by-side in browser. Auto-highlights missing/changed vars, drift summary, export fixed .env. No upload, instant.
items.call_to_action: Try pasting sample env files - does it catch your drifts? Feedback via issues.

items.title: Cron Viz: No-Signup Visualizer & Validator for Cron Expressions
items.summary: Instantly parse/validate cron strings: next 10 runs listed, field breakdown (min/hour/etc.), syntax errors highlighted, TZ support. No server/login. Solves 'mental parsing' pain (Reddit: r/golang, r/graylog, r/IMadeThis).
items.call_to_action: Paste a cron (e.g., '0 9 * * 1-5') → see results instantly. Feedback welcome!
